prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1337; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded. Do you understand and agree to that?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Great. Can you tell me in your own words what happened at the intersection in Pasadena, Texas?

A: I was turning left off the main road into the shopping center. I had my signal on and I was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic. When it looked clear, I started my turn, and that's when another car came through and hit the driver's side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?

A: Not really. I think it was coming down the road a bit fast, but I didn't get a good look at it until the impact.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did the airbags deploy?

A: Yes, the side airbag went off, and my shoulder slammed into the door frame and the center console.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My right shoulder is really sore. I can't lift my arm above my shoulder without pain, and I've got a headache and some stiffness in my neck.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or been to an emergency room since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you think I should know about how the accident happened?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to make sure my shoulder gets properly looked at.

Q: Understood. Thank you for your time. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
